column3: pəhaḍkə bʰasajə̃ krija hamrə bʰasajə̃ kədzija kəhətahĩ.
column4: (The death ritual) is called 'kriya' in Pahade language (Nepali language) but 'kajiya' in ours.
column6: pəhaḍkə bʰasajə̃ krija hamrə bʰasajə̃ kədzija kəhətahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.001.

column3: ə̃ pəhile morne sit sətigəti kərike kʰənijə̃ beṭa cʰawa bʰəine sit dui bʰai tin bʰai ek bʰai dzəmmei ṭikike bar gʰugʰatahĩ muḍʰ kʰurtahĩ gʰaṭəjə̃
column4: Yes, if (someone) dies, in doing death ritual, if one has sons, they receive Tika (mark on the forehead) and shave the heads right in the cremation grounds.
column6: ə̃ pəhile morne sit sətigəti kərike kʰənijə̃ beṭa cʰawa bʰəine sit dui bʰai tin bʰai ek bʰai dzəmmei ṭikike bar gʰugʰatahĩ muḍʰ kʰurtahĩ gʰaṭəjə̃
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.002.
Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.003.

column3: gʰər aikunu ekṭa pahaḍe cʰep ekṭa mədʰese cʰep.
column4: Having come home, (there are two ways of death rituals), one Pahade Chep, another Madhesi Chep.
column6: gʰər aikunu ekṭa pahaḍe cʰep ekṭa mədʰese cʰep.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.004.

column3: pahaḍe cʰep kərne sit gʰər aikunu sag bʰat nun kʰəitahĩ.
column4: If the ritual is perfomed according to Pahade Chep, (the men in mourning) eat rice and curry with salt after they come home.
column6: pahaḍe cʰep kərne sit gʰər aikunu sag bʰat nun kʰəitahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.005.

column3: mədʰese cʰep kərne sit dudʰse bʰat kʰəitahĩ begər nunkə.
column4: If the ritual is perfomed according to Madhesi Chep, (the man in mourning) eat rice and milk without salt.
column6: mədʰese cʰep kərne sit dudʰse bʰat kʰəitahĩ begər nunkə.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.006.

column3: tin din səmmə hame nun cʰaḍtahĩ.
column4: We do not eat (lit. leave) salt for three days.
column6: tin din səmmə hame nun cʰaḍtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.007.

column3: əse bəllə nun kʰəitahĩ rə morlə dinse dawa kərtahĩ.
column4: Then only salt is eaten and Dawa is performed from the day of death.
column6: əse bəllə nun kʰəitahĩ rə morlə dinse dawa kərtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.008.

column3: morlə din ek dawa arkon din dui dawa tisrən din tin dawa.
column4: One Dawa on the day (a man) died, two Dawa on the next day and three Dawa on the third day.
column6: morlə din ek dawa arkon din dui dawa tisrən din tin dawa.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.009.

column3: tə dawa meṭit bəllə əse nunse bʰat kʰəitahĩ.
column4: As Dawa ends, the rice is eaten with salt.
column6: tə dawa meṭit bəllə əse nunse bʰat kʰəitahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.010.

column3: pʰeri uhəi rəhəi abe u tə kədzija kərike.
column4: There he is, now he has to do kajiya (death ritual).
column6: pʰeri uhəi rəhəi abe u tə kədzija kərike.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.011.

column3: apʰnə mənkə kura abe pʰeri dui məhinajə̃ pʰeri kərtahĩ tin məhinajə̃ pʰeri kərtahĩ turuntei pʰeri kərtahĩ.
column4: The things you wish may be done within two months, three months (or) immediately.
column6: apʰnə mənkə kura abe pʰeri dui məhinajə̃ pʰeri kərtahĩ tin məhinajə̃ pʰeri kərtahĩ turuntei pʰeri kərtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.012.

column3: ucʰise kədzija tʰalne sit gəḍuwa dʰərlə kəhətahĩ.
column4: Then if the kajiya begins, (that ) is called gaduwa holding.
column6: ucʰise kədzija tʰalne sit gəḍuwa dʰərlə kəhətahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.013.

column4: If the death ritual begins, (we'll) send message (to relatives).
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.014.

column3: celibeṭi pʰupucela mamacela car cʰak nun barike pərit.
column4: The sisters and aunt (father's sisters), the relatives on their side and maternal uncle's side should not eat salt (lit. leave salt) for four times (two days).
column6: celibeṭi pʰupucela mamacela car cʰak nun barike pərit.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.015.

column4: Then (we) go to the cremation grounds.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.016.

column4: Then Pindo (a ball of rice to offer) is made.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.017.

column3: tə pinḍo parikunu ucʰika kərtahĩ hamrə kəhideũ tin kisimkə aṭəi.
column4: Having made Pindo, it is done there. Let me say, there are three ways (kinds) of doing this.
column6: tə pinḍo parikunu ucʰika kərtahĩ hamrə kəhideũ tin kisimkə aṭəi.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.018.

column4: The ritual (ending of Kajiya) is finished on the cremation grounds.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.019.

column4: The cleansing is done on the cremation grounds.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.020.

column3: ekṭa ciŋni ek dzor pərewa ledzikun caḍʰane sit oralə.
column4: If you leave a hen and a pair of pigeon, it (the ritual) is finished.
column6: ekṭa ciŋni ek dzor pərewa ledzikun caḍʰane sit oralə.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.021.

column4: End of Kajiya is done right in the cremation ground.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.022.

column3: tə arkon tərikə koi ijə dzəbəre ə̃usi kəhətahĩ pahaḍe bʰasajə̃ hame əməusa kəhətahĩ.
column4: The next (type of mourning ritual) is on the day which is called Aunsi (the new moon) in Nepali language, and Amausa in our language.
column6: tə arkon tərikə koi ijə dzəbəre ə̃usi kəhətahĩ pahaḍe bʰasajə̃ hame əməusa kəhətahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.023.

column3: uhəi dinse gʰərəjə̃ hame pʰuləu rakʰtahĩ morlə manuskə naũjə̃.
column4: We keep Phulau from the same day on the name of the dead person (recalling the dead).
column6: uhəi dinse gʰərəjə̃ hame pʰuləu rakʰtahĩ morlə manuskə naũjə̃.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.024.

column4: That is kept one day and then ended.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.025.

column3: pʰeri arko dəsəhĩkə car pãc dinəjə̃ bʰəit bəḍkə bʰat kəhətahĩ.
column4: The day in the next four or five days is called Badka Bhat (lit. big rice).
column6: pʰeri arko dəsəhĩkə car pãc dinəjə̃ bʰəit bəḍkə bʰat kəhətahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.026.
Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.027.

column3: uhəi uṭʰaikun ṭaŋgtahĩ rə ekei coṭi aguhi bihibar pəilete rəhəi
column4: The ceremony may be extended till Thursday if it (the death) is on Thursday.
column6: uhəi uṭʰaikun ṭaŋgtahĩ rə ekei coṭi aguhi bihibar pəilete rəhəi
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.028.

column3: abe tə uhəi sohoraikə aũsi pəiletahat.
column4: The half moon with the approaching of Sohorai approaches (lit. is found).
column6: abe tə uhəi sohoraikə aũsi pəiletahat.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.029.

column3: aũsijə̃ murti rakʰikunu tin din səmmən rakʰtahĩ.
column4: Having kept the idol for three days on the day of half moon, it is done (the process continued) for three days.
column6: aũsijə̃ murti rakʰikunu tin din səmmən rakʰtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.030.

column3: tin din pugte car bədze pãc bədze gʰərse pʰuləu uṭʰatahĩ selatahĩ.
column4: The Phoulou is picked up, and cremated finally from the house from four to five o'clock when the three days are over.
column6: tin din pugte car bədze pãc bədze gʰərse pʰuləu uṭʰatahĩ selatahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.031.

column3: arko nidzə səklaharə gʰərəjə̃ rakʰike gʰaṭihĩ nei səbʰəitʰok səman ledzikun ek cʰin gʰaṭəjə̃ rakʰtahĩ.
column4: After completing the next day from home, taking all things from home, this is placed there for some time.
column6: arko nidzə səklaharə gʰərəjə̃ rakʰike gʰaṭihĩ nei səbʰəitʰok səman ledzikun ek cʰin gʰaṭəjə̃ rakʰtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.032.

column3: gʰəreikə dzəhin murti banaikunu ukʰrake selai detahĩ.
column4: Having made the statue like idol at home, they cremate it.
column6: gʰəreikə dzəhin murti banaikunu ukʰrake selai detahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.033.

column4: Having come from there, Phulpati (flower) is searched.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.034.

column3: ukrə dzon morlaharəkə cʰahok cʰahik baṭik ukrake gaũkə manuseĩ gaũ səmadz milikun ṭopi goro perikun bərkʰi bartahĩ.
column4: All people gathering from neighbourhood, the white dress is worn (to him), the sons of the the dead man.
column6: ukrə dzon morlaharəkə cʰahok cʰahik baṭik ukrake gaũkə manuseĩ gaũ səmadz milikun ṭopi goro perikun bərkʰi bartahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.035.
Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.036.

column3: rəŋgin luga dzʰula gone lagai detahĩkansəb.
column4: We dress them the colourful clothes such as blouses and sarees.
column6: rəŋgin luga dzʰula gone lagai detahĩkansəb.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.037.

column4: We give them the colourful clothes, blouse and are worn to them.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.038.

column3: hamrə sə̃skriti ihəi baṭəi dərəikə mərənkə.
column4: This is our culture, the rituals of the death of Darai.
column6: hamrə sə̃skriti ihəi baṭəi dərəikə mərənkə.
column7: Source narrative: Death Ritual; speaker: Cham Narayan Darai. Source recording locality: Kathar VDC, Chitwan district. Source text identifier: DR.CND.039.

column4: Yeast is made from a kind of bush (plant).
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.001.

column3: surujə̃ caur bʰidzaikun dzʰãgi bonse anikun sukʰaikun kuṭike pərit.
column4: In the beginning having drenched rice, having dried the (leaves of medicinal) bushes from jungle, (we) should pound them.
column6: surujə̃ caur bʰidzaikun dzʰãgi bonse anikun sukʰaikun kuṭike pərit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.002.

column4: Dry in the sun first, and then pound (bush and rice).
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.003.

column4: Make flour (after) beating the moistened rice.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.004.

column3: əse piṭʰa banaikunu uwə piṭʰa kuṭlə dzʰãgise misaike.
column4: Then having made the flour, mix it with the bush and the rice which have been pounded.
column6: əse piṭʰa banaikunu uwə piṭʰa kuṭlə dzʰãgise misaike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.005.

column3: uwə misaikunu cukti cukti pani gʰalike.
column4: Having mixed (the flour) add (lit. pour) a little water.
column6: uwə misaikunu cukti cukti pani gʰalike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.006.

column3: pani ṭʰik matra gʰalikun ḍəlla pərne dzəsnə bʰəine par ḍəlla parike.
column4: When (flour) is likely to be shaped into balls after having added appropriate quantity of water, turn them into balls.
column6: pani ṭʰik matra gʰalikun ḍəlla pərne dzəsnə bʰəine par ḍəlla parike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.007.

column4: After having made the balls and kept them in the basket, spread (it) in the basket.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.008.

column3: sutate dzaḍa məhina bhəine par puwar əlik baklo rakʰike pərit.
column4: While spreading, if the season is cold, (we) should spread it in the thick straw.
column6: sutate dzaḍa məhina bhəine par puwar əlik baklo rakʰike pərit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.009.

column3: tərə gərəm məhina bhəine patro patro rakʰike.
column4: Keep in a thin (layer) if the season is hot.
column6: tərə gərəm məhina bhəine patro patro rakʰike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.010.

column4: Next day the yeast becomes white.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.011.

column3: əse ərkə dinəjə̃ patsəb puwar haṭaikun rakʰike.
column4: Then, keep (it) by (having) removed the leaves and straw next day.
column6: əse ərkə dinəjə̃ patsəb puwar haṭaikun rakʰike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.012.

column3: rakʰne par uwə mərca əli həlka rə gorə bənit.
column4: If the yeast is kept separate, it becomes a bit light and white.
column6: rakʰne par uwə mərca əli həlka rə gorə bənit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.013.
Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.014.

column3: uwə mərca uṭʰaikunu ekṭa bʰə̃ḍija ḍeli kʰendʰri ətʰəwa kjahau sukʰkʰa bʰə̃ḍijajə̃ rakʰike.
column4: Keep the yeast in any pot like Deli, Khendhri, or in some other dry pots after lifting the yeast.
column6: uwə mərca uṭʰaikunu ekṭa bʰə̃ḍija ḍeli kʰendʰri ətʰəwa kjahau sukʰkʰa bʰə̃ḍijajə̃ rakʰike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.015.

column3: osekəri bənlə mərcake hame cʰuṭṭəi agikə rapʰkə nədzik dzʰunḍaikun rakʰtahĩ.
column4: We hang the yeast made in this way in a separate place near the fire.
column6: osekəri bənlə mərcake hame cʰuṭṭəi agikə rapʰkə nədzik dzʰunḍaikun rakʰtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.016.

column3: ijə mərca ek dekʰi dui həpta bʰitrə gʰalike bʰəit.
column4: The yeast should be poured (into a pot) within one to two weeks.
column6: ijə mərca ek dekʰi dui həpta bʰitrə gʰalike bʰəit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.017.

column3: uwə mərca bəni səklə pəcʰi bʰatijə̃ haltahĩ.
column4: The fermented rice is mixed (put with yeast) after the yeast is ready.
column6: uwə mərca bəni səklə pəcʰi bʰatijə̃ haltahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.018.

column3: mod hamrə ekdəm məhətwəpurnə cidz həkʰəi.
column4: Mod (a type of home made beer) is a very important thing of us.
column6: mod hamrə ekdəm məhətwəpurnə cidz həkʰəi.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.019.

column3: mod hamrə dərəikə nəbʰəi naibʰəi kikekəte kʰəna mod ənek kaməjə̃səb cahit.
column4: The beer is an indispensable thing for us because this is required in several (religious) occasions (lit. works).
column6: mod hamrə dərəikə nəbʰəi naibʰəi kikekəte kʰəna mod ənek kaməjə̃səb cahit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.020.
Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.021.

column3: uwə mod kəske banaike kəhi məi kəhəte aṭə-m.
column4: I tell (you) how the beer is made.
column6: uwə mod kəske banaike kəhi məi kəhəte aṭə-m.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.022.

column3: mod dʰerei ənnəsəbkə bʰəit tərə mod kʰas kərikun makaikə banatahĩ.
column4: The beer is made from several grains but it is mainly made from maize grains.
column6: mod dʰerei ənnəsəbkə bʰəit tərə mod kʰas kərikun makaikə banatahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.023.

column3: makaike sukʰaikunu əlik kʰəsrə kʰəsrə kərikun pisike.
column4: Having made the maize grain, dry in the hot son (and) grind the maize grains rather coarsely.
column6: makaike sukʰaikunu əlik kʰəsrə kʰəsrə kərikun pisike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.024.

column3: kʰəsrə kʰəsrə kərikun pisike səkne par uṭʰaikun pʰəḍkikun dʰoikun ṭʰikkə parike.
column4: Make ready the grains after the grains are ground coarsely, and lifted (it), purified and washed.
column6: kʰəsrə kʰəsrə kərikun pisike səkne par uṭʰaikun pʰəḍkikun dʰoikun ṭʰikkə parike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.025.

column4: Heat water in a big boiling pot.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.026.

column3: odʰən dʰikne par dʰoulə caur gʰalike.
column4: If the boiling pot is hot, add the rice which is washed.
column6: odʰən dʰikne par dʰoulə caur gʰalike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.027.
Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.028.

column3: bʰat dzəhin cʰəḍkike suru bʰəit. cʰəḍkəne par səbdzʰaike.
column4: The rice-like things begin boiling. If it boils, leave it to be boiling.
column6: bʰat dzəhin cʰəḍkike suru bʰəit. cʰəḍkəne par səbdzʰaike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.029.

column4: Mix (the powder) into the cooked rice (for a while).
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.030.

column3: gərəm məhinajə̃ purei ciso banaikun rə dzaḍaun məhina bʰəine par məntato bʰəine par mətrei sutaike pərit.
column4: (It) should be spread only after getting cold if it is a hot season but if it is a cold season it should be spread only after it (becomes) a bit warm.
column6: gərəm məhinajə̃ purei ciso banaikun rə dzaḍaun məhina bʰəine par məntato bʰəine par mətrei sutaike pərit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.031.

column3: sutlarə kəte əgaḍi bʰatike məsinəse pʰoḍeike rə mərcakə ḍəllakə bʰatikə matra ənusar dui tin ḍəllake məsinəse maḍikun dʰulo banaikun pʰoḍlə bʰatise mocʰike.
column4: Earlier to spreading the brewed rice, mix them (fermented rice and yeast) with two or three balls of crushed yeast in relation to the quantity of fermented rice.
column6: sutlarə kəte əgaḍi bʰatike məsinəse pʰoḍeike rə mərcakə ḍəllakə bʰatikə matra ənusar dui tin ḍəllake məsinəse maḍikun dʰulo banaikun pʰoḍlə bʰatise mocʰike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.032.

column3: sutate kʰəna sutlarə bʰə̃ḍijajə̃ tərə ek pətrə pat ḍisaike əse mərca rə bʰati misaike.
column4: While spreading in the pot, there should be a pot of layer of leaves, and the mix the yeast and fermented rice.
column6: sutate kʰəna sutlarə bʰə̃ḍijajə̃ tərə ek pətrə pat ḍisaike əse mərca rə bʰati misaike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.033.

column4: Spread the rice right above it.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.034.

column4: Again cover it with a layer of leaves.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.035.

column3: ḍʰaki səkne par uhəi bʰati ḍʰakikun beske kʰãdʰike əse keṭakeṭĩ nidzə bʰeṭlarə ṭʰaũjə̃ rakʰike.
column4: When it begins boiling, you should sqeeze and keep it in the place where children do not reach it.
column6: ḍʰaki səkne par uhəi bʰati ḍʰakikun beske kʰãdʰike əse keṭakeṭĩ nidzə bʰeṭlarə ṭʰaũjə̃ rakʰike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.036.

column4: A Bhanti (leaf of a kind of plant) in particular is required.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.037.

column4: If Bhandi leaf is not available, saal leaves also work.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.038.

column3: dui din pacʰu bʰatise dzʰor bohit.
column4: The liquid starts to flow after two days.
column6: dui din pacʰu bʰatise dzʰor bohit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.039.

column3: dzʰor bohone par mod sawad bʰəit rə ijə bela uṭʰaike pərit.
column4: If liquid flows, the beer becomes sweet and this should be kept this time.
column6: dzʰor bohone par mod sawad bʰəit rə ijə bela uṭʰaike pərit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.040.

column3: kũḍake dʰoikun bərsijə̃ sukʰaike obane par bʰati uṭhaikun kũḍajə̃ gʰalike.
column4: Having washed the pot (Kunda), it is kept dry near the fire (and) if it is hot it is lifted and kept in a water vessel.
column6: kũḍake dʰoikun bərsijə̃ sukʰaike obane par bʰati uṭhaikun kũḍajə̃ gʰalike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.041.

column3: əse uhəi sutalə patkə kũḍakə buckono banaikun ṭʰəmmə bʰəilarə kərikun kəsike.
column4: Tighten the neck of the pot, having tightened it with same leaves used for spreading.
column6: əse uhəi sutalə patkə kũḍakə buckono banaikun ṭʰəmmə bʰəilarə kərikun kəsike.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.042.

column3: eske rakʰlə dzətka dʰerei pacʰu kʰaike suru kərlə otkai mod sawad bʰəit.
column4: The later you begin drinking, the tastier it becomes after it is kept like this.
column6: eske rakʰlə dzətka dʰerei pacʰu kʰaike suru kərlə otkai mod sawad bʰəit.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.043.

column3: tərə koḍajə̃ gʰallə dui din pacʰu kʰaike suru kərtahĩ.
column4: But (beer) is started to be drunk after 2 days of keeping it in the pot.
column6: tərə koḍajə̃ gʰallə dui din pacʰu kʰaike suru kərtahĩ.
column7: Source narrative: How to make wine; speaker: Samita Darai. Source recording locality: Kathmandu. Source text identifier: HtMW.SD.044.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.001. Source speaker-turn label: Q.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.002. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: From what (how) were we named Darai ?
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.003. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: Eh, First we did not have a king.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.004. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: tʰarukə tʰaru radza rəhəi guruŋ guruŋ məgər məgər
column4: Tharu had a Tharu king, Gurung had a Gurung king and Magar had a Magar king.
column6: tʰarukə tʰaru radza rəhəi guruŋ guruŋ məgər məgər
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.005. Source speaker-turn label: A.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.006. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: rəhəte kʰənijə̃ hamrake ləkʰəṭte kʰəni u.
column4: In such a case, they drove our king.
column6: rəhəte kʰənijə̃ hamrake ləkʰəṭte kʰəni u.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.007. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: We were Darais from the beginning.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.008. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column3: ote pəhaḍkə məhətəuke midzar kəhəte rəhəs.
column4: The chief (Mukhiya) of the hill used to be called Mijar.
column6: ote pəhaḍkə məhətəuke midzar kəhəte rəhəs.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.009. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: dəməulijə̃ ukrə naũ nei midzar aṭikan ni.
column4: In Damauli his name is Mijhar, isn't it so ?
column6: dəməulijə̃ ukrə naũ nei midzar aṭikan ni.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.010. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: aguhin pəhaḍəjə̃ pəhaḍke punu midzʰar kəhəlarə cələn rəhəi.
column4: Then (long ago) in the hills, there was a tradition of calling the people living in the hills Mijhar.
column6: aguhin pəhaḍəjə̃ pəhaḍke punu midzʰar kəhəlarə cələn rəhəi.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.011. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: hame ete mohotəu cəutəre kəhələ dzəhin ote pahaḍəjə̃ midzʰar.
column4: As we call Mohotau, (and) Chautare, they call Mijhar (in the hills) that side.
column6: hame ete mohotəu cəutəre kəhələ dzəhin ote pahaḍəjə̃ midzʰar.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.012. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: He has to be like that !
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.013. Source speaker-turn label: Q.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.014. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column3: pidrənijə̃ dʰerei piḍarkə rukʰ rəhələhun uhəigunei pidrəni rəhələhun.
column4: Perhaps there were several trees of Pidar (trees) in Pidrahani. Therefore this place is called Pidrahani.
column6: pidrənijə̃ dʰerei piḍarkə rukʰ rəhələhun uhəigunei pidrəni rəhələhun.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.015. Source speaker-turn label: Q.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.016. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: hame dərəi dzati cãhi kitise rəhələ hətahai.
column4: How might have we Darai people been named Darai ?
column6: hame dərəi dzati cãhi kitise rəhələ hətahai.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.017. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: There is a saying, you know.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.018. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: (They) were much frightened and therefore (named) Darai.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.019. Source speaker-turn label: Q.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.020. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: pauke abe məi umṭe kura cʰinikun kura kərtəm hai.
column4: I will now ask you one thing, having cleared the matter of other sides.
column6: pauke abe məi umṭe kura cʰinikun kura kərtəm hai.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.021. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: Long ago we had our king.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.022. Source speaker-turn label: A.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.023. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: aguhĩ dərəikə dərəi nei radza rəhəi tʰarukə tʰaru nei guruŋkə guruŋ nei rəhəihun.
column4: Long ago Darai had a Darai king, Tharu had a Tharu king, and Gurung had a Gurung king.
column6: aguhĩ dərəikə dərəi nei radza rəhəi tʰarukə tʰaru nei guruŋkə guruŋ nei rəhəihun.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.024. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: eske dzatei bʰərikə radzjə bʰəite kʰəna hamrakehun ləkʰəṭlə
column4: In this way, as there were kings of each caste, we were driven away.
column6: eske dzatei bʰərikə radzjə bʰəite kʰəna hamrakehun ləkʰəṭlə
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.025. Source speaker-turn label: A.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.026. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: lə həi tʰər punu dzʰun kəhə hai.
column4: "You know, don't tell your caste, okay ?"
column6: lə həi tʰər punu dzʰun kəhə hai.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.027. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: sodzʰəi dərəikə dərəi kəhə hai kəhikun kəhələ.
column4: He told (them) to say straightforwardly that the Darais were called Darai.
column6: sodzʰəi dərəikə dərəi kəhə hai kəhikun kəhələ.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.028. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: Having run away from here, the offspring of the king went.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.029. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: hame cãhi ekṭa dukṭa cʰuṭlə cãhi pəhaḍpəṭṭi dzəiləhun.
column4: We are probably one or two who were left behind went towards the hills.
column6: hame cãhi ekṭa dukṭa cʰuṭlə cãhi pəhaḍpəṭṭi dzəiləhun.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.030. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: Was there also the king even in Chitwan ?
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.031. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: Yes, there was also a king even in Chitwan.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.032. Source speaker-turn label: A.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.033. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column3: kʰəi ijə uwə ṭʰaũ tə nidzə pətta.
column4: I donot know whether this or that place.
column6: kʰəi ijə uwə ṭʰaũ tə nidzə pətta.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.034. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: Makai Bhutne Budho used to say the matters (things) (he had) spoken and heard.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.035. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: Do they say they came from this side ?
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.036. Source speaker-turn label: Q.
Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.037. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: (They) went earlier having left all the properties.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.038. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: (One) had to save his life (lit. body), isn't it ?
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.039. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: (One) had to be loyal (lit. should do ) to service of other people.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.040. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column4: How long did he rule here ?
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.041. Source speaker-turn label: Q.

column4: (I don't know) how long he ruled.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.042. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: kəi bərsə etka otka tə nidzə tʰaha.
column4: I don't know this much or that much (lit. this much long or that much long).
column6: kəi bərsə etka otka tə nidzə tʰaha.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.043. Source speaker-turn label: A.

column3: hamrə radzakə naũ kjahau rəhəi kəhit nihidzə kəhələ herəu babu.
column4: I do not know how our king was named, let's see my dear (son).
column6: hamrə radzakə naũ kjahau rəhəi kəhit nihidzə kəhələ herəu babu.
column7: Source narrative: Interview; speaker: Mangal Ram Darai and a woman. Source text identifier: In.UN.044. Source speaker-turn label: A.
